mapper.select: SELECT t1.CORP_GR , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , TO_CHAR(t1.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tr_ymd , t1.TR_CD , t1.FUND_CD , t1.TR_CO_CD , t1.TRUSTEE , t1.JM_CD AS yj_cd , t1.CURRENCY , t1.TR_SEQ , TO_CHAR(t1.GYULJE_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS gyulje_ymd , t1.GYULJE_AEK , t1.WON_GYULJE_AEK , t1.GYULJE_GB , t1.GYULJE_JM_CD , ya.JM_NM AS xx_yj_cd , ya.JASAN_GB , t1.WON_HWAN_CHA , t1.SURY_AEK , t1.BS_TYPE , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , ia.FUND_CURRENCY , t1.FCUR_GYULJE_AEK , t1.FCUR_HWAN_CHA AS syt0ys_fcur_hwan_cha , t1.BUNHAL_AEK , 1 AS p_visible , t1.FUND_CD AS orig_fund_cd , t1.JM_CD AS orig_yj_cd , t1.TRUSTEE AS orig_trustee , t1.TR_CO_CD AS orig_tr_co_cd FROM SYT0YS t1 , SYM0YA ya , SZM0IA ia WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND t1.TR_CD = 'E2P' AND ya.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ya.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD AND ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD ORDER BY t1.FUND_CD ASC , t1.JM_CD ASC
SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd FROM SYT0YS t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_CD = 'E2P' ORDER BY ymd
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SYT0YS ( CORP_GR , YMD , TR_YMD , TR_CD , FUND_CD , TR_CO_CD , TRUSTEE , JM_CD , CURRENCY , TR_SEQ , GYULJE_YMD , GYULJE_AEK , WON_GYULJE_AEK , GYULJE_GB , GYULJE_JM_CD , WON_HWAN_CHA , SURY_AEK , BS_TYPE , FCUR_GYULJE_AEK , FCUR_HWAN_CHA , BUNHAL_AEK ) VALUES ( #{corpGr, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') , TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{trYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') , NVL(#{trCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'E2P') , #{fundCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , NVL(#{trCoCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '00000') , #{trustee, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{yjCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{currency, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{trSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} , TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{gyuljeYmd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') , NVL(#{gyuljeAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) , NVL(#{wonGyuljeAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) , NVL(#{gyuljeGb, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y') , #{gyuljeJmCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{wonHwanCha, jdbcType=NUMERIC} , NVL(#{suryAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) , NVL(#{bsType, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) , #{fcurGyuljeAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC} , #{syt0ysFcurHwanCha, jdbcType=NUMERIC} , #{bunhalAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
